# agentgateway_effective_config (Data Source)

The effective configuration the gateway is serving, as returned by `/api/config/effective`. The document is marked sensitive because it can contain provider credentials and API key material.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# The merged configuration the gateway is currently serving.
data "agentgateway_effective_config" "current" {}

# The whole document is sensitive because it can contain provider credentials
# and API key material, so the output must be marked sensitive as well.
output "effective_config" {
  value     = data.agentgateway_effective_config.current.json
  sensitive = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `json` (String, Sensitive) The effective configuration document as normalized JSON. Marked sensitive as a whole.
